purpose: Classify source migrations without rewriting immutable provider history.

classifications.description: History-only or replay-receipt file for an already-live provider migration.
Temporary, recovery, probe, or retirement control retained for provenance.

invariants: Every migration is classified exactly once.
Receipt references must point at an existing source file.
Historical controls remain source history and are not silently deleted.
Provider-exact recovery files preserve ledger bytes and version identities; pending source-authority review is recorded in the separate provenance receipt.
